rewrite.note: save_every is max(40, n//3) at train time so the run keeps two intermediate checkpoints. Loss is the local CE in exp8/train8.py. r/alpha stay on the init adapter (r=32, alpha=64).

close.note: Train (c) only if some unguarded or guarded two-pass row meets all of these.

sweep.note: Sweep (d) only if some scored two-pass row is otherwise passing and voice is within 0.05 of 4.3, and only on checkpoints of the (c) run.

second_source.note: Run q4_merged_rag pass-1 on the strongest primary adapter only if every primary rewrite is at or below this must-answer count. Pass-1 v_merged_v_rag is 59/60 and q4_merged_rag is 58/60, so a rewrite that stays at 58 or 59 does not get a second source.
